## Why it matters

- **Expectation-setting from the same lineage we already replicate.** The vault holds his published-system captures ([[2026-09-16-systematicpeter-15pct-exposure-nasdaq-mean-reversion]], queued for rules-pull) and his meta-view on publishing research ([[2026-09-04-systematicpeter-why-publish-research]]); this tweet is the affective counterweight — the drawdown texture between the equity highs that marketing never shows.
